title: Apple Cobbler Crumble
subtitle: A super-easy layered apple cobbler — the fruit juices bake into the cinnamon crumb.

method.title: Crumble and layers
items: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C); grease a 9×9-inch baking dish with {@grease}
Mix {@flour}, {@sugar}, {@butter} and {@cinnamon} in a bowl with a pastry blender or fork until crumbly
Reserve {¾ cup} of the crumb mixture for the topping
Sprinkle a light layer of crumb into the dish and top with a layer of the sliced fruit
Keep alternating crumb and apples, ending with apples; sprinkle the reserved crumb over the top

method.title: Bake and serve
items: Bake until the apples are tender and the topping is lightly browned, 30–35 min
If the topping browns before the apples are tender, cover loosely with {@foil}
Serve warm, with {@ice-cream} if you like; keeps 3 days covered in the fridge

method.label: Toddler — her serving
items: Scoop a small square once it has cooled to just warm — the fruit stays hot longer than the crumb
Mash the apples lightly with a fork and cut the crumb into small pieces

method.label: Tip
method.text: Sugar and butter are the reduced amounts from the notes on the printout (the original used 1 cup sugar and ½ cup butter). No self-rising flour? Use 1 cup all-purpose flour + 1½ tsp baking powder + ¼ tsp salt. Fresh peaches work in place of apples.
